title: GitHub Issue Comment Count Leaderboard
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:issue comment_count=*
| stats sum(comment_count) as total_value, avg(comment_count) as avg_value by label
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks label values by total and average comment count across GitHub issue events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `comment_count` values for each GitHub issue event and review total and average comment count by label.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total comment count.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which label shows the biggest comment count numbers in your GitHub issue data.
